title: Chandra and XMM-Newton have observed neutron star spectra.
purpose: Name specific space telescopes and their role.
narration: Two powerful space telescopes, NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory and ESA's XMM-Newton, have both observed the unique spectra of neutron stars, helping us understand their extreme environments.

These observations help us understand the extreme environments of neutron stars.
